title: Nextest Group Executor
description: Run one serial nextest test group under a bound sized from the tests its filter selects.

command.description: The group's nextest run. Runs unchanged once the count stage has sized its bound.

listCommand.description: The same selection listed as JSON (nextest list --message-format=json). Its selected, non-ignored tests size the bound.

cwd.description: Working directory. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

killAfterMs.description: Most milliseconds a timed-out command gets after graceful termination before its process group is force-killed.
